full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 49 of 1998 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, 6th Court, Dhaka impleading the Opposite Party No.1 as defendant praying for a decree for ejectment of the said defendant from the suit premises. The suit was subsequently transferred to the learned Assistant Judge, 5th Additional Court, Dhaka and was renumbered as title Suit No. 8 of 1999. The plaintiff alleged that the defendant No. 1 is a tenant under the plaintiff at a monthly rental of Taka 2000 and subsequently became a defaulter in payment of monthly rent.
